notes: Untagged MPEG-1/2/2.5 Layer III. The mpegFrames check parses the frame header (version, layer, bitrate, sample rate, padding) and requires a second valid, consistent frame header exactly one frame later. A frame sync is a weak header: it never ends a carve that still has an end rule to find. The mp3 walker follows the frames to the end of the stream and an optional APEv2/ID3v1 trailer.
